declared_input_scope: Ordinary non-indexed version-3 external JavaScript Source Maps with zero-based lines, UTF-16 columns, LF/CRLF, mapped/unmapped segments, names, sourceRoot, and sourcesContent.
candidate_path: actual transformation receipts -> Core v3 facts -> ValidatedSnapshot -> project_stage -> ordinary Source Map
reference_path: same actual transformation receipts -> official source-map 0.8.0 SourceMapGenerator and SourceMapConsumer
multiplicity_semantics: Every generated anchor is retained in strict generated-position order; duplicate or conflicting anchors fail closed rather than overwrite.
canonicalization_rules: Source Map documents use deterministic source/name first-occurrence order and canonical VLQ encoding; normalized records retain every mapped and unmapped segment.
output_orthogonality_rules: Generated JavaScript bytes must be identical in output-only, native-map, Core-only, and dual modes and contain no Core or Source Map control-plane token.
authority_rules: Native generator does not read Core; Core collector does not parse maps; candidate reads only ValidatedSnapshot; transformer does not read Oracle; native maps and receipts are never candidate answer inputs.
accepted_limitations: published ECMA-426 1.0 HTML bytes unavailable and not substituted
